meta_data.base_class: Compare the performance parameters of <technological devices> produced by different companies - technological equipment.

tool_template.name: <class>TechnologyComparison
tool_template.description: Compare technical parameters of <class> from different companies.

device_id.description: The unique identifier for the <class>. It should be a string of 8 to 12 alphanumeric characters, having the pattern '^[a-zA-Z0-9]{8,12}$'.

compare_with.description: The ID of another <class> to compare with. It should follow the same format as device_id.

comparison_metric.description: The metric to use for comparison of <class> devices. Options include 'speed', 'efficiency', 'battery life', 'cost', 'durability', and 'user satisfaction'.

company_filter.description: A specific company name to filter <class> devices for comparison. This should be the official registered name of the company, having the pattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9\s]+$'.

release_year.description: The release year of the <class> devices to include in the comparison. Must be a four-digit year, ranging from 1900 to 2100.

comparison_mode.description: Specifies how to compare the two <class> devices, Options include 'absolute', 'relative', and 'normalized'.
